# Verifies `dump lowered --list` succeeds for every shipping platform.
# InlinePure runs always-on (Plan G); fyne also opts into NoStdlibWrappers.

sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps:'
stdout 'passes: InlinePure'

sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform fyne --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoReactivity,NoStdlibWrappers,NoDeclarative'
stdout 'passes: NoReactivity . InlinePure . NoDeclarative'

sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,NoReactivity'
stdout 'passes: NoAsyncReactive . NoReactivity . InlinePure'

sngl dump lowered --lang none --platform html --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps: NoAsyncReactive,NoReactivity'
stdout 'passes: NoAsyncReactive . NoReactivity . InlinePure'

sngl dump lowered --lang kotlin --platform android --list main.sngl
stdout 'caps:'
stdout 'passes: InlinePure'

# Unknown pass name surfaces a non-zero exit.
! sngl dump lowered --lang go --platform bubbletea --after NoBogus main.sngl

-- main.sngl --
component main {
    text(value="hello")
}
